verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships an official, documented CLI. The docs and homepage show `npx auth init` and device-authorization testing through the CLI, and community users confirm using it to generate tables and migrations. Nothing in the evidence shows the CLI is designed for AI-native or agent-driven use, so the agentic part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented AI- or agent-oriented CLI behavior (non-interactive or scriptable modes, machine-readable output), a full command reference in the evidence, and hands-on corroboration of CLI use in agentic workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can test the device authorization flow right now using the Better Auth CLI
The CLI-generated migration made switching easy.
